invariants.name: THREE_WORLD_SEPARATION
invariants.rule: Evidence, interpretation, and decision remain distinguishable.

invariants.name: STRICT_POINT_IN_TIME
invariants.rule: No information first available after analysis cutoff may enter decision research.

invariants.name: PROVENANCE_REQUIRED
invariants.rule: Decision-material evidence must retain reconstructable provenance.

invariants.name: UNKNOWN_FIRST_CLASS
invariants.rule: Unknown, unavailable, unresolved, and not identified may not silently collapse to zero/neutral.

invariants.name: NO_FAKE_PRECISION
invariants.rule: Numeric probability/confidence requires an explicit epistemic type and calibration basis when asserted as calibrated.

invariants.name: CLAIM_TYPE_EXPLICIT
invariants.rule: Material assertions should be typed as observation, report, measurement, estimate, proxy, model output, association, causal hypothesis, mechanism, narrative, regime, forecast, scenario, expert judgment, decision rule, unknown, unresolved, or not identified.

invariants.name: CAUSAL_AUTHORITY_EARNED
invariants.rule: Causal certainty requires temporal order, mechanism and non-NOT_IDENTIFIED identification state.

invariants.name: CONTRADICTION_VISIBLE
invariants.rule: Material contradictory evidence may not be silently suppressed.

invariants.name: SOURCE_DEPENDENCY_VISIBLE
invariants.rule: Multiple wrappers around one root source are not independent evidence.

invariants.name: PROXY_NOT_REALITY
invariants.rule: A proxy may not be presented as direct observation of its latent target without an explicit proxy contract.

invariants.name: MODEL_NOT_FACT
invariants.rule: Model output remains identifiable as model output downstream.

invariants.name: EXPLORATION_NOT_CONFIRMATION
invariants.rule: Search-discovered specifications do not inherit confirmatory authority without validation.

invariants.name: NO_RETROACTIVE_HISTORY_REWRITE
invariants.rule: Method upgrades create reanalysis, not silent rewriting of historical knowledge states.

invariants.name: AUDITABLE_FLEXIBILITY
invariants.rule: Protocol adaptation and exceptions must be explicit and versioned.
